payload.ranking_principle: machine rankings and factor maps may prepare context but must never decide whether an in-scope company receives rapid triage; intake ordering is administrative only and no ranking may directly promote a company to a formal profile, deep research, underwriting or buy_now
payload.research_value_principle: allocate the next research hour where it is most likely to change a portfolio decision; uncertainty that is expensive or unresolvable lowers priority
payload.stop_principle: a stop is an auditable research-capital decision, not a permanent investment verdict; every non-structural stop requires a reactivation trigger
payload.comparison_principle: formal-profile capacity is allocated only after the complete rapid-triage cohort is sealed; an independent cross-company agent must review every cohort member and submit an explicit decision for each one, including companies whose first-pass disposition did not recommend promotion, and completion order or deterministic score must not affect promotion
